decisions.reason: Building directly on the firm's existing dietary supplement capabilities, the firm can readily assimilate and improve it, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
Because it is closely related to existing supplement knowledge and had a clear launch, the firm can interpret results and learn, making a drop unlikely.
As a related dietary supplement with early quantified launch but only website mention, the firm still has enough related knowledge to learn and likely keep it.
Although mushroom-based is somewhat novel, it still builds on supplement capabilities, giving moderate absorptive capacity and a low chance of being dropped.
Distant from the firm's established offer and with a serious quality problem, the firm lacks the related knowledge to assimilate and fix it, making withdrawal highly likely.
Distant from the firm's established offer and with no observed market presence or learning signals, limited absorptive capacity makes withdrawal likely.
